messages:
marco: Heads up — the cafetière in Kitchen B cracked this morning when I tried to rinse it. Tiny split near the spout, still leaks. Can anyone bring a spare French press or travel press today? Also quick poll: bagels tomorrow morning? :bagel: :raised_hands:
ana: Ugh nooooo the press? I'll bring my AeroPress around 9 if that helps (won't be same ritual but will do). Also I'm in for bagels. Everything plain everything. :yum:
devon: I can swing by the bakery at 8:30 and grab a mixed pack if folks want. Any dietary needs? Gluten-free?
marco: @devon amazing, thank you. One GF option would be great (karen prefers GF).
karen: I appreciate the GF option — also can someone re-label the shared spice jars? The paprika jar is missing its sticker and now everything is chaos. :sweat_smile:
sophie: I'll do a quick label run at lunch. Suggestion for labels (printed sticky notes) — format: "item — opened MM/DD — owner" so we can track leftovers. Example: ```paprika — opened 03/23 — kitchen"
marco: Love that. Also small PSA: please don't put uncovered soups in the fridge top shelf; rats of Tupperware are multiplying. :pleading_face:
nana: noted. I'll leave a sticky on the microwave reminding people to cover. Could we add a short fridge rule in the kitchen channel?
devon: Fridge rule: "Label, cover, toss after 7 days" — good compromise. I'll pin it. :pushpin:
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Weekly kitchen inventory + label check" set for Fridays at 3pm.
karen: For tomorrow's bagels — I'm team everything with chive cream cheese. If devon can get a GF sesame-free one, I'll bring chive spread.
marco: AeroPress + bagels plan confirmed. @devon leaving at 8:30 works. Thanks everyone. Small ask: if you borrow mugs, please put on the drying rack — too many disappearing into desks. :coffee:
nana: Also who has the metal scooper for the big coffee canister? I've been searching.
sophie: I have it! Left it on the top shelf of the pantry. I'll tape a note. :pushpin:
marco: Perfect. See you all tomorrow bright and caffeinated. :sun_with_face:
